description: This Java source file defines integration tests for the 'LoanWithAdvancedPaymentAllocation' feature in the Apache Fineract project. It tests creating and reading loan products with advanced payment allocation strategies, verifies proper setup, and updates existing configurations. The file includes test setup, helper methods for creating JSON payloads, and test cases annotated with JUnit 5.

classes.name: LoanWithAdvancedPaymentAllocationIntegrationTests
classes.description: A JUnit 5 test class that verifies the creation, retrieval, and updating of loan products with advanced payment allocation within the Fineract integration test suite.

methods.name: setupTests
methods.description: Initializes test environment, including REST assured configuration, account setup, and helper object instantiation.

methods.name: testCreateAndReadLoanProductWithAdvancedPayment
methods.description: Test case that creates a loan product with advanced payment allocation, creates a loan account, verifies the allocation rules, and updates the loan product to ensure changes are persisted.

methods.name: createLoanJSON
methods.description: Builds JSON payload for creating a loan product with specified advanced payment allocations.

methods.name: updateLoanProductRequest
methods.description: Constructs request payload to update existing loan product with new advanced payment allocations.

methods.name: createLoanAccount
methods.description: Creates a new loan account based on provided client ID, loan product ID, and operation date.

methods.name: createRepaymentPaymentAllocation
methods.description: Generates an AdvancedPaymentData object configuring repayment allocation rules.

methods.name: createDefaultPaymentAllocation
methods.description: Generates an AdvancedPaymentData object with default allocation rules.

methods.name: getPaymentAllocationOrder
methods.description: Creates list of PaymentAllocationOrder entries based on provided PaymentAllocationTypes, assigning order sequences.
